title: SEBI Bars Avadhut Sathe, Academy; Imposes ₹11.5 Crore Penalty
description: The market regulator SEBI has permanently barred Avadhut Dinkar Sathe and his academy, ASTAPL, from the securities market. They have been directed to disgorge.

faq.q: What is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser (RIA)?
faq.a: An RIA is an individual or entity registered with SEBI to provide investment advice for a fee. They must meet specific qualification criteria, adhere to a code of conduct, and act in the client's best interest, offering a layer of protection to investors.

faq.q: How can I check if an investment advisor is registered with SEBI?
faq.a: You can verify an advisor's registration by visiting the official SEBI website (sebi.gov.in). Look for the "Investment Advisers" section, which typically has a searchable database of all registered entities and individuals.

faq.q: What does "disgorgement" mean in the context of SEBI's order?
faq.a: Disgorgement is a legal remedy where an entity is ordered to repay profits or funds obtained illegally or through unethical means. In this case, Avadhut Sathe and ASTAPL must return ₹546.17 crore collected from investors for unregistered services.

faq.q: What should I do if I believe I was a victim of an unregistered investment advisor?
faq.a: If you have paid for services from an unregistered advisor, you should gather all relevant documentation (payment proofs, communication, service agreements) and monitor SEBI's official announcements for information on the refund process. You can also file a complaint through SEBI's SCORES platform.

faq.q: Can unregistered entities offer financial education or workshops?
faq.a: While offering general financial education or workshops is permissible, if these activities involve providing specific investment advice, recommendations on securities, or promising returns for a fee, they fall under SEBI's regulatory ambit and require registration as an Investment Adviser.

fact_check.summary: The article accurately reports on SEBI's action against Avadhut Sathe and ASTAPL, including the penalties and disgorgement amount, and correctly outlines SEBI's role and regulations for investment advisors.
